rules.notCommon: Not a common, easily guessed password

password.changedOk: Password changed. Your sessions on other devices have been signed out.
password.forcedBody: Before you continue, choose a new password only you know. The current password of {email} was created or is known by someone else, so it has to be changed first.
password.pageIntro: For {email}. Once changed, your sessions on other devices are signed out automatically.
password.linkIncomplete: This link is incomplete. Open the full link from your invitation, or ask your administrator for a new one.
password.setDone: Password set for {email}. You can now sign in.
password.singleUse: This link can only be used once.

branch.title: Branch profile
branch.intro: {name} ({slug}). Printed on every contract and invoice, shown on the storefront, and used by the WhatsApp auto-reply to point customers to this branch's CS.
branch.readOnly: Read-only: only an organization-scoped Admin (Super Admin) can change the branch profile.
branch.confirmPkpOn: Turn PPN ON for this branch? Invoices issued from now on will carry PPN 11%. Invoices already issued do not change.
branch.confirmPkpOff: Turn PPN OFF for this branch? Invoices issued from now on carry no PPN. Invoices already issued do not change.

console.title: Console name
console.label: Name shown in the console
console.hint: Shown in the sidebar, the sign-in page, the browser tab and staff account emails. Applies to the whole organization. Leave blank to use “{default}”.

identity.title: Identity
identity.name: Branch name
identity.codeHint: 2–6 capital letters or digits, unique in the organization — the {BRANCH} in document numbers.
identity.legalNameHint: Leave blank to use the organization's.
identity.orgLegalNameHint: The lessor in the contract, e.g. PT Servis Storej Indonesia.
identity.timezoneHint: Document numbers take their month and year from this timezone.

tax.title: Tax (PPN)
tax.pkp: This branch is PKP — invoices carry PPN 11%
tax.hint: Applies only to invoices issued after you save. Invoices already issued never change. While off, tax rows disappear from invoices, contracts and the portal quote.

contact.title: Customer service contacts
contact.description: Printed in the document header; the auto-reply uses the WhatsApp number.
contact.whatsappHint: The branch's own CS number, as on the website — not the system number that sends notifications.

address.title: Address
address.description: One line per row, as printed.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.description: Listed on the storefront branch page.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.description: Accounts marked “show on invoice” appear in the invoice's Payment Method block and in the portal's transfer instructions.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.tokens: Tokens: {BRANCH} branch code, {M}/{MM} month, {YYYY} year, {D}/{DD} day, {CUST} customer number, {SEQ} or {SEQ:4} the running number (zero-padded), and on invoices {CONTRACT} the number of the contract it belongs to. Contracts and invoices count separately.
numbering.preview: With the saved format, for customer #36 and running number 40: contract {contract}, invoice {invoice}. Save to refresh the preview.

online.title: Online payment
online.toggle: Customers can pay invoices online from the portal
online.noGateway: This deployment has no payment gateway yet (Xendit is not configured), so online payment stays off. Customers see the bank transfer details above and are asked to send their transfer proof to WhatsApp CS; payments are recorded by staff and verified by a second person.
online.offHint: While off, the portal hides Pay and shows the bank transfer details instead.

api.title: API access
api.toggle: Allow API keys, the read-only external API and outbound webhooks for this branch
api.hint: Turns on the API Access page. A key reads this branch's bookings and invoices (customer data included) and stays valid until revoked — create one per system and revoke any you no longer use.

legacy.title: Imported rentals (Booqable)
legacy.toggle: Hold automatic invoices and payment reminders for rentals imported from Booqable
legacy.hint: While on, the console issues no monthly invoice and sends no due or overdue reminder for the rentals and invoices imported from Booqable — they are still billed there. Bookings and invoices made in the console are not affected. Turn this off on cut-over day, once Booqable is no longer used: the console then bills and reminds those customers itself.

testMode.title: Test mode
testMode.toggle: This branch is in its test period — data will be wiped before go-live
testMode.hint: While on, every console page warns that the renters, contracts and invoices in this branch are test data that will be wiped before go-live. It is only a marker: it changes nothing about how the system works. Turn it off once the test data is wiped and the real data imported.

branch.savedNote: Saved — the change is in the audit log.

msgSettings.title: Messaging
msgSettings.intro: WhatsApp is how customers hear from you — booking confirmations, waitlist places, KYC links, invoices and payment reminders. One number serves every branch in the organization.

source.organizationDetail: Messages to customers go out through the WhatsApp number configured here, for every branch in the organization.
source.environmentDetail: Nothing is saved here yet, so messages use the credentials set on the server. Saving a number below takes over from them.
source.defaultDetail: Customer messages are written to the notification log but never delivered. Add a WhatsApp number below to start sending.

pause.title: Pause all messaging
pause.pausedBody: Nothing outbound reaches a provider: notifications, reminders, the auto-reply and inbox replies are recorded as suppressed. Incoming messages are still recorded.
pause.explain: Stops every outbound WhatsApp and email for all branches at once — use it during a data migration or if something is sending that shouldn't. Each held-back message is recorded as suppressed so you can see what would have gone. The legacy data import refuses to run unless messaging is paused.
pause.reasonPlaceholder: Reason, e.g. Data migration from Booqable
pause.onlyOrgAdmin: Only an organization-scoped Admin (Super Admin) can pause or resume messaging.
pause.reasonRequired: Say why messaging is being paused — the reason is shown in the banner on every page.
pause.confirmPause: Pause ALL outbound messages (WhatsApp and email) for every branch? Messages will be recorded as suppressed instead of sent.
pause.confirmResume: Resume sending? Review the suppressed messages first — anything held back while paused is NOT sent automatically.

msgSettings.readOnlyNote: You can see how messaging is set up. Changing the number, pairing, auto-reply or pause needs an organization-scoped Admin (Super Admin), because they apply to every branch.
msgSettings.noSecretKey: The API has no MESSAGING_CONFIG_KEY set, so an access token can't be stored securely and saving one will be refused. Generate a key with openssl rand -hex 32, set it on the API and restart.

how.title: How the system sends
how.linked: On — send from the linked WhatsApp number above
how.cloud: On — send via WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta, needs approved templates)
how.phoneNumberIdPlaceholder: From Meta Business Suite → WhatsApp → API Setup
how.tokenSaved: Saved — leave blank to keep it
how.tokenHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current one.

auto.title: Reply automatically to incoming messages
auto.intro: When a customer messages your WhatsApp number, send this back — at most once per number per cooldown, and not while a person on your team has replied within it. Their message and the reply both appear in the inbox.
auto.placeholder: Thanks — we've got your message and will reply shortly.
auto.placeholders: Placeholders, filled from Settings → Branch profile: {branchName}, {branchWhatsapp}, {branchPhone}, {branchContact} (CS WhatsApp, else phone, else email) — the customer's own branch, or the first branch for an unknown number — and {allBranches}, one “Branch: WA … · Tel …” line per branch. Example: “Halo! Nomor ini hanya untuk notifikasi otomatis. Untuk pertanyaan, hubungi CS {branchName}: {branchContact}.”
auto.cooldownHint: At most one automatic reply per number in this window. Default 12.
auto.systemNumberHint: The one number every customer message is sent from, for all branches. It only notifies: it cannot be saved as a branch's CS contact, and the auto-reply never points customers back to it.

test.title: Send a test message
test.intro: Sends a short test message to one number so you can confirm the connection works. With the linked number selected above, the test goes through it even before you save; for the Cloud API, a number and token typed above are used instead of the saved ones. Test sends aren't recorded against any customer.
test.loggedOnly: Sending is off, so the message was written to the log instead of delivered.

users.title: Users & roles
users.introOrg: Staff accounts and their role × scope. As a Super Admin you see every branch; new users are created in this branch — switch branches to add users elsewhere.
users.introBranch: Staff accounts and their role × scope. You manage users for your branch.
users.needAdmin: You need an admin role to manage users.
users.resetConfirm: Send a password reset link to {name}? Their old password stops working at once and all their sessions are signed out.
users.resetFailed: The reset link could not be created.

notice.emailed: The link to set a password was sent to that email. It can be used once and is valid for 72 hours.
notice.notEmailed: The email was not sent (email is not configured, or messaging is paused). Copy this link and give it directly to the account's owner only. It can be used once, is valid for 72 hours, and will not be shown again.

import.title: Import CSV
import.description: Columns: email, display_name, role, scope, branch_slug, notes (the go-live data pack's go-live-users.csv). Role is ADMIN, FINANCE, SUPERVISOR or STAFF; scope is ORGANIZATION or TENANT (a TENANT user needs a branch_slug). Nobody gets a password: each new user receives a single-use link to set their own.
import.branchOnly: As a branch Admin you can only add users to your own branch.
import.linksNote: Each person sets their own password with their link. Links are single use and valid for 72 hours. They were also emailed — but while messaging is paused, emails are suppressed, so hand these over directly (in person or by WhatsApp) and to their owner only.

form.noPassword: No password: the new user receives a single-use link to set their own.
form.orgScopeOnlySuper: Only a Super Admin can grant organization-wide scope

csv.fixErrors: Fix the errors in the file and choose it again — nothing is imported while any row has an error.

allowlist.title: Test mode — send only to test numbers
allowlist.onlyOrgAdmin: Only an organization-scoped Admin (Super Admin) can see and change the test numbers.
allowlist.loadFailed: The test numbers could not be loaded.
allowlist.notPhone: "{value}" is not a phone number. Use the international format, e.g. +628111877838.
allowlist.confirmEmpty: The test list is empty. If test mode is turned on now, NO message is sent to anyone. Continue?
allowlist.confirmOn: Turn test mode on? Messages will only go to the {count} numbers on this list. Messages to any other number are recorded as held back, not sent.
allowlist.confirmOff: Turn test mode off? Messages then go to ALL customers as usual. Messages already held back are not re-sent.
allowlist.saveFailed: Could not save the test numbers.
allowlist.explain: While test mode is on, WhatsApp and email only reach the numbers on this list. Messages to any other number — and every email — are recorded as held back and never re-sent. Use it during the test period, while the branch holds test renters or freshly imported real customers.

linked.confirmUnlink: Unlink this WhatsApp number? The system stops sending until a number is paired again.
linked.notConfigured: The WhatsApp bridge isn't set up on this deployment. Deploy apps/wa-bridge and set WA_BRIDGE_URL and WA_BRIDGE_TOKEN on the API and worker to link a number here.
linked.title: Linked WhatsApp number
linked.explain: The system sends from your own WhatsApp number as a linked device, the same way WhatsApp Web does. There's no Meta approval and no templates: booking, KYC, invoice and reminder messages go out as soon as the number is connected. The phone stays the main device; keep it online at least every few days, or WhatsApp unlinks it after about 14.
linked.sentToday: Sent today: {sent} of {cap} (the daily cap, counted per Jakarta day and kept across restarts). Messages are spaced a few seconds apart to keep the number in good standing.
linked.step1: On the phone with this number, open WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices.
linked.step2: Tap Link a device, then Link with phone number instead.
linked.step3: Type the code above. This page turns Connected by itself.

reports.title: Reports
reports.loadFailed: The report could not be loaded.
reports.noAccess: Your account has no access to the financial reports. Reports are for Admin and Finance only.

exports.title: Data export
exports.hint: CSV files for the selected range. Amounts in rupiah without thousands separators, dates and times in WIB; they open directly in Google Sheets and Excel.
exports.invoicesHint: Every invoice by issue date, with contract number, unit and deposit.
exports.paymentsHint: Every payment by payment date, including those awaiting verification and failed ones.
exports.ledgerHint: Every debit and credit entry in the range.
exports.contractsHint: Contracts created in the range, with customer, unit and signature status.
exports.footer: The sales report, financial summary, AR aging and customer list have their own download button in their tab. The deposit report is on the Deposits page.

clients.title: Customers
clients.hint: Who rents what, since when, and whether they are healthy (paid), at risk (due within 7 days), overdue or inactive. Click a customer for details.

sales.loadFailed: The sales report could not be loaded.
sales.title: Sales
sales.hint: How much was sold and how much came in over the selected range.
sales.defSalesText: Invoices issued in the range, without deposits. Voided or credited invoices are not counted.
sales.defReceivedText: Payments that succeeded in the range, by payment date (not the date recorded). It matches the bank statement, so it includes deposits paid with the rent.
sales.defDepositText: Shown separately and never counted as sales. Net cash in = received minus deposits refunded.
sales.endedSub: Renters who moved out in the range
sales.transactionsHint: One row per payment, in WIB.

summary.loadFailed: The financial summary could not be loaded.
summary.title: Financial summary
summary.hint: Revenue, sales, received and deposits are movements within the range. AR and deposits are as of the end of the range.
summary.revenueSub: Recognized when the invoice is issued
summary.balancesAt: Balances at the end of the range ({date})
summary.notPkpSub: This branch does not charge PPN
summary.ledgerHint: Opening balance before the range, debits and credits within it, and the closing balance.
summary.noLedger: No ledger entries up to the end of this range yet.

ar.loadFailed: AR aging could not be loaded.
ar.title: AR aging
ar.hint: As of {date}: what is overdue and what is coming due. Click a group to see its invoices.
ar.hintFuture: As of {date} (today — the range ends in the future): what is overdue and what is coming due. Click a group to see its invoices.
ar.totalLine: {count} unpaid invoices · total {amount} (including scheduled bills of fixed-term contracts).

range.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
